title: 第23章 来自女帝的浓浓爱意第24章 女帝情深活出第二世
slug: 叛出家族后转身投靠魔族女帝
lines: 女帝林书望很生气，非常生气。
自己暗恋了三年的男人只身一人，独闯帝宫，冒死出现在面前。
先是一通温暖到骨子里的情话连番表白，后又送出神凰精血这等珍贵的天地异宝。
然后
留下一句我修为尽失，沦为凡俗，配不上你。
且重伤未愈，早已是油尽灯枯之象，没几日可活得了。
为了不连累、不拖累、不麻烦
最后不等自己反应，脚底抹油，直接开溜。
这是闹哪样？
知道自己不能修炼配不上自己，没几日活得了，还不远万里来招惹自己干嘛？
想来就来，想走就走，当她这神焰帝宫是摆设不成？
该说的话，你都说出口了，人生不留遗憾了，可以慷慨赴死。
可老娘呢？！
老娘的这颗心都被你撩动了，你说你要走？
你是表白完了，可本帝本帝还没说同意不同意呢？
你洒脱！
你清高！
你无所谓！
哼，那本帝呢？！
等女帝从愤怒和震惊中回过神来，眼瞅著始作俑者楚尘即將推开帝宫宫门，情急之下，那火爆脾气上来了，一掌拍出。
在圣级巔峰修为的女帝面前，已经沦为凡俗的楚尘没有半点反抗之力。
且女帝虽是含怒出手，但並无杀意，体內的极道帝兵吞天魔罐也不会被唤醒。
没有丝毫意外，沐浴著猩红火焰的巨大掌印击中楚尘后，楚尘连哼一声都来不及，就直接被打得原地晕死过去。
这还是女帝手下留情，否则若是使出万分之一的功力，楚尘的身体也早已在巨大的掌印下，化作飞灰。
唰！
楚尘的身体倒地之前，女帝施展咫尺天涯神通，瞬间出现在宫门口，將昏迷中的楚尘抱在怀中。
“哼，本帝不准你死，你便不能死！”
“配不配得上本帝，不是你说了算，而是本帝说了算！”
“只要是本帝喜欢的男人，你若比本帝强，你便在上面，本帝在下面！你若比本帝弱，那本帝便在上面，你在下面！”
也幸得此刻楚尘早已被一张拍晕过去，幸得恢宏的帝宫中没有其他人。
否则任谁听了如此彪悍的虎狼之词出自高冷女帝林书望之口，也会被惊掉下巴，彻底地怀疑人生。
望著怀中晕死过去的楚尘，女帝林书望那漂亮的大眼睛里闪过一丝柔情，又闪过一丝决绝，像是做了一个重大的决定似的：
“本帝这辈子最不喜欢欠別人，既然既然听了你说那么多好听的情话，既然收了你的定情信物”
“哼，於情於理，本帝本帝都会回赠一份礼物给你。”
女帝林书望抱著楚尘的身体，俏脸微红，再无此前半分高冷模样，反倒是像极了情竇初开的邻家少女。
原来所谓高冷、孤傲，一直都只是女帝林书望的保护色。
content_en:
Empress Lin Shuwang was very angry, very angry.
The man she had been secretly in love with for three years broke into the imperial palace alone and risked her life to appear in front of her.
First, there was a series of confessions of love that were heart-warming to the core, and then he gave precious treasures such as the essence and blood of the Divine Phoenix.
then
I left a sentence saying that I have lost all my cultivation and become an ordinary person, not worthy of you.
Moreover, the serious injury has not yet healed, and the oil has already been exhausted, and there are only a few days left to live.
In order not to be involved, not to be a drag, not to be troublesome
In the end, without waiting for a reaction, he rubbed oil on his soles and walked away.
What's going on?
If you know that you can't cultivate, you're not worthy of yourself, and you won't be able to survive for a few days, why would you come thousands of miles away to provoke yourself?
She can come whenever she wants and leave whenever she wants. How can she treat her Divine Flame Emperor Palace as just a decoration?
You have said everything that needs to be said. You will have no regrets in life and you can die generously.
But where is my mother? !
My heart has been touched by you. You said you want to leave?
You have finished your confession, but I haven’t said whether I agree or not yet?
You are free and easy!
You are noble!
It doesn't matter to you!
Humph, what about me? !
When the empress recovered from her anger and shock, she saw Chu Chen, the instigator, about to open the door of the imperial palace. In desperation, her fiery temper came to the fore and she struck out with a palm.
In front of the empress who was at the peak of the holy level, Chu Chen, who had been reduced to a mortal, had no power to resist.
And although the empress acted out of anger, she had no murderous intention, and the Heaven-Swallowing Devil Jar, the ultimate imperial weapon in her body, would not be awakened.
Bang! !
There was no surprise at all. After the huge palm print bathed in scarlet flames hit Chu Chen, Chu Chen was knocked to the spot and fainted before he even had time to grunt.
This was because the Empress had shown mercy, otherwise if he had used one ten thousandth of his power, Chu Chen's body would have been turned into ashes under the huge palm print.
Uh-huh!
Before Chu Chen's body fell to the ground, the empress used her magical power to appear at the gate of the palace and held the unconscious Chu Chen in her arms.
"Humph, if I don't allow you to die, you can't die!"
"Whether you are worthy of this emperor or not is not decided by you, but by this emperor!"
"As long as you are a man that I like, if you are stronger than me, you will be on top and I will be below! If you are weaker than me, then I will be on top and you will be below!"
""
Fortunately, Chu Chen had already fainted from the photo. Fortunately, there was no one else in the magnificent imperial palace.
Otherwise, anyone who hears such tough words of tiger and wolf coming from the mouth of the cold empress Lin Shuwang will be shocked and will completely doubt their life.
Looking at Chu Chen who fainted in her arms, Empress Lin Shuwang's beautiful big eyes flashed with a trace of tenderness and a trace of determination, as if she had made a major decision:
"I hate being in debt to others in my life. Now that I have heard you say so many nice words of love, and now that I have accepted your token of love,"
"Huh, if it's both emotional and reasonable, I will give you a gift in return."
Empress Lin Shuwang hugged Chu Chen's body, her pretty face was slightly red, she no longer looked aloof like before, but she looked like the girl next door who was just beginning to fall in love.
It turns out that the so-called aloofness and aloofness have always been just the protective color of the empress Lin Shuwang.
title_en: Chapter 23: Deep Love from the Empress Chapter 24: The Empress’ Love and Living the Second Life
